name: How long does a typical door sill repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door sill repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes for a door sill repair varies depending on the extent of the damage and the type of material. A simple repair for minor rot or surface damage might take a few hours, while a complete sill replacement due to extensive structural issues could take a full day or more. For Maine Results, Inc., assessing the damage accurately during a consultation helps us provide a precise timeline. The process clarity is that more extensive damage involving adjacent door frame components will naturally extend the repair duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Door sill repair can take a few hours for minor damage or a full day for extensive replacement, depending on the issue.
